policy: Sanitized decision summaries only. Original review materials remain private; hashes identify bytes, not public retrieval or acceptance evidence. No transcripts, machine paths, chat/session identifiers or future source pins.

supersession.prior: EX-003 restriction against inventing attachment/voice semantics

supersession.prior: Recent-only or room-only Threads, experimental entry and notification-derived unread
supersession.decision: First-class cross-room Unread/Recent; authoritative receipt state plus honest coverage; durable device-local activity is not read state.

supersession.prior: Release-to-send voice and automatic post-permission recording
supersession.decision: Release-to-preview; fresh activation after first permission grant; Send only from preview.

supersession.prior: Content equality as composer draft ownership
supersession.decision: Immutable revision lease; equal text after a new edit remains newer.
